critical_code_review_comments: PreviewPanel.jsx line 542 renders codebase-err only when viewMode==='code' AND codebaseErr is truthy. In this sandbox the tree call returned 401 but the codebase-err banner didn't surface in-panel because a project-level 'GitHub access revoked' banner higher in Dashboard already claims the visual real estate — arguably fine (single source of truth), but worth confirming the in-panel err also renders for projects that DON'T trip the dashboard-level revoked banner (e.g. never-connected projects). Non-blocking.

The /file endpoint returning 404 'File not found: README.md' rather than 401 'GitHub PAT invalid or expired' when the PAT is actually expired is a slight UX oddity — get_repo_token seemingly returns None/expired token silently and fetch_file bubbles up the resulting GitHub 404 (rather than 401). Users may be confused. Consider preflight-validating the PAT inside get_project_file the same way loop_engine's preflight does, so the error message is 'GitHub PAT invalid or expired' when that's the real cause. Non-blocking for this ship.
